subject: [PATCH 12/60] mm/vmscan: restrict reclaim to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch restricts reclaim to common memory by modifying kswapd and MGLRU's debugfs interface. It leaves direct reclaim unaffected.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts reclaim to common memory by modifying kswapd and MGLRU's debugfs interface to only operate on nodes marked as N_MEMORY_COMMON. Direct reclaim is left unaffected.
